rules.statement: The burden of proving title or possession lies with the decree-holder when an obstructor has satisfied the Court that they are a bona fide claimant.
rules.supporting_quote: "But when once the obstructor has satisfied the Court on that point, the application of section 377 (b) has exhausted itself, and the initial and ultimate burden of proving title or possession, as the case may be, is on the decree-holder."
